anchors.exact_quote: The composition of the engine coolant is as follows: water to dissipate the heat and a coolant additive as corrosion protection. Engine coolant, like fuel and lubricating oil, is a medium that must be carefully selected, treated and controlled. Otherwise, corrosion, erosion and cavitation can occur on the walls of the cooling system which are in contact with water and deposits can form.
anchors.candidate_span: 冷却液成分应为水加冷却液添加剂（腐蚀保护），且须经选择、处理与控制，防止冷却系统接触水的壁面发生腐蚀、侵蚀、气蚀和沉积形成。
